title: 疑问词 + to do / too…to / enough to

questions.stem: Can you tell me ____ to use this machine?

options.distractor: 问的是使用方法，不是“什么”

questions.explanation: 怎么用这台机器 → how to use。

questions.stem: The room is ____ small ____ hold so many people.

options.distractor: enough 要放在形容词后面

questions.explanation: 太小装不下这么多人 → too small to hold。

questions.stem: He is strong ____ to carry the heavy box by himself.

options.distractor: too…to 表示“太……而不能”，意思相反
very 不与 to do 构成此结构
so 要搭配 that 从句

questions.explanation: 足够强壮能搬动 → strong enough to carry。

questions.stem: — ____ to start the meeting? — Let's start at eight.
questions.explanation: 答语是八点，问的是什么时候 → when to start。

options.text: The tea is too hot to drink.
She is careful enough to do the job.
I don't know where to go.
The desk is too heavy for him to carry it.

questions.explanation: the desk 已经是 carry 的逻辑宾语，末尾不能再加 it。

questions.stem: — Could you tell me ____ to do next? — Sure. Let's clean the classroom.

options.distractor: how to do 后面要接宾语，这里没有
答语是做什么，不是时间
答语是做什么，不是地点

questions.explanation: 问“下一步做什么” → what to do。
